JIRA:KAFKA-20668
Motivation
The kafka-metadata-shell tool exposes a option --snapshot to point at the file to read. The flag name is misleading: the metadata snapshot use the .checkpoint suffix, while kafka also has .snapshot files in log directory which are producer snapshots. This leads users to pass the wrong file.
This KIP proposesadding a --checkpoint option and deprecating --snapshot (keeping it as an alias for backward compatibility).
Public Interfaces
This KIP changes the command-line arguments of kafka-metadata-shell.sh.
A new option will be added: --checkpoint <path>. The existing options will remain supported as deprecated aliases: --snapshot <path>, -s <path>.
Example: bin/kafka-metadata-shell.sh --checkpoint metadata_log_dir/__cluster_metadata-0/00000000000000007228-0000000001.checkpoint
Proposed Changes
Add --checkpoint as the preferred option for selecting the metadata checkpoint file.
Keep --snapshot and -s as deprecated aliases for compatibility. When either deprecated alias is used, the tool will print a deprecation warning recommending --checkpoint.
Only one of --checkpoint, --snapshot, or -s may be specified in a single invocation. The KRaft operations documentation will be updated to use --checkpoint.
Compatibility, Deprecation, and Migration Plan
This change is backward compatible.
Existing scripts using --snapshot or -s will continue to work, but users should migrate to --checkpoint.
This KIP does not remove --snapshot or -s. Any future removal should be handled separately.
There are no protocol changes, storage format changes, or broker-side behavior changes.
Test Plan
The change will be covered by metadata shell argument parsing tests and existing metadata shell integration tests.
The tests will verify that:
--checkpoint is accepted.
--snapshot and -s remain accepted and emit a deprecation warning.
using both the new option and a deprecated alias is rejected.
invoking the tool without a checkpoint option is rejected.
existing shell commands passed after the checkpoint file are preserved.
